newsitem.title: UK: Pound slows rise in output at British Steel.
newsitem.headline: Pound slows rise in output at British Steel.

text.p: British Steel was set to show it produced a continued rise in output last year but had a slower rate of growth in the face of sharp price cuts and the persistent strength of sterling, the Independent reported on Tuesday.
The newspaper said figures from the company, to be released at the end of this month, would show crude steel output hit 16.12 million tons in 1996, up from 15.7 million tons the previous year.
But the 25 percent rise in the value of sterling over the past year had taken its toll on profitability, said the newspaper.
It quoted analysts as saying the production figures showed market share had been maintained at the cost of slashing prices.
